schema1.title: JSON Recipe Edit Schema
schema1.description: the schema definition for EzTerry's JSON Recipe Edit

commands

file.description: The file to load as a JSON Script

count.description: if not set to -1 (default) only remove recipes that return a stack of this many items per craft
size of the item stack to return [default = 1]

mirrored.description: Can the recipe be mirrored (default = true)

count.description: size of the item stack to return [default = 1]

name.description: Name of the ore dictionary entry

items.description: List of items to add to this ore dictionary entry

count.description: Number of items that smelt per craft

xp.description: amount of XP to give 0.1 by default.

trigger.description: The trigger when this command chain is to be ran

dim.description: The dimention to run on, use "*" to run on all/any loaded dimention, default "*"

log.description: if we log output or not, useful for debugging but otherwise spams the log, default: false

name.description: name of the command chain (displayed in server/log messages from the commands, default "VCommandChain"

oneOf.description: the system (command block) command to run

droporiginal.description: To keep the original drops for the block or not default=true

dropone.description: Drop one item from the weighted list, (otherwise odds of each item are separate) default=false

silkdropone.description: Drop one item from the weighted list when silk touching, (otherwise odds of each item are separate) default=<value of dropone>

fortunemultiplier.description: if dropone=false, multiply each entry by this number for each level of fortune default 1.10

dropchance.description: chance of collected items are dropped 1.0 = 100%, default = blocks default rate

count.description: size of the item stack default=1

weight.description: Weight of the item, if dropone=false: 1.0 = 100% drop, else is used as a weight with all other entries

drops.description: list of possible drops and odds

count.description: size of the item stack default=1

weight.description: Weight of the item, if dropone=false: 1.0 = 100% drop, else is used as a weight with all other entries

silktouch.description: list of drops when using silk touch (same as drops if omitted entirely)

exp.description: amount of exp to drop when not silk touched (default -1, the original amount)

meta.description: blockstate of the block being broken default: ""

hardness.description: The block hardness default: current value

resistance.description: The block resistance default: current value

unbreakable.description: if true make unbreakable, else current state, to make breakable set hardness

harvestlevel.description: The blocks harvest tool/level: default: current value

unlocalizedname.description: The untranslated name of the block default: current value

lightlevel.description: The light level of the block default: current value

lightopacity.description: The light level of the block default: current value

slipperiness.description: The slipperiness of the block default: current value

harvestlevel.description: The blocks harvest tool/level: default: current value

unlocalizedname.description: The untranslated name of the block default: current value

maxdamage.description: the maximum damage a tool can have default: current value

norepair.description: if true prevent the item from being repaired false/omitted keep current value

maxstack.description: the maximum stack size of this item default: current value

to.description: The new value to set the items to

from.description: The original value to change (default: -1 to change make 'to' the new maximum)

modifiercount.description: Number of modifier items to consume per craft

count.description: Number of items to return per craft

levels.description: Cost in levels of the craft

count.description: size of the item stack to return [default = 1]

tool.description: Tool to craft the item with

fluid.description: The result fluid of melting recipes to remove (matches both metal and amount)
